name: Sandbox0
description: Runs agent-generated code in managed cloud sandboxes with pause/resume and persistent root filesystems, through an auth-gated REST API and a CLI.

skills.name: Create Sandbox
skills.description: Provisions an isolated cloud sandbox for running untrusted or agent-generated code via the REST API or CLI.

skills.name: Pause and Resume
skills.description: Pauses a running sandbox and resumes it later with its root filesystem state preserved across the gap.

skills.name: Manage Files
skills.description: Reads and writes files inside a sandbox, backed by a persistent root filesystem across the sandbox lifecycle.
